description: This file defines the ViewsEntityRow class, which implements ContainerDeriverInterface to provide derivative definitions for entity row plugins in Drupal views, specifically for non-special entity types with views integration.

classes.name: ViewsEntityRow
classes.description: Provides derivative definitions for entity row plugins based on entity types with views integration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the plugin with base plugin ID, entity type manager, and views data service.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the class using a container and base plugin ID.

methods.name: getDerivativeDefinition
methods.description: Returns the derivative definition for a given derivative ID, generating derivatives if necessary.

methods.name: getDerivativeDefinitions
methods.description: Generates derivative definitions for entity types that have views integration.
